title: Building Custom Make.com Apps
summary: This day covers essential concepts for building AI engineering skills.
topics: Make.com Custom Apps overview and app structure
Connections (API key, OAuth2) and base configuration
Remote Procedure Calls (RPCs) for dynamic fields
Testing, versioning, and publishing custom apps
practical_task_reference: In the Make.com custom app builder, create an app for a public API: configure the base and an API-key connection, and build one action module and one search module, then test them in a scenario.
mini_project_reference: Build a custom Make.com app with OAuth2 connection, a polling trigger with deduplication, an action module, and at least one RPC-powered dynamic dropdown, versioned and tested against real API calls.
assignment_reference: Explain what an RPC is used for in a Make.com custom app and compare polling vs instant (webhook) triggers from the app developer's perspective, including the dedup/registration concerns of each.
